_comment: Registry for scripts/weekly_scorecard.py. start_ts = epoch seconds of the bot RESTART that activated the change (NOT commit time — all four below shipped 2026-06-11 but apply on restart). start_ts=0 -> NOT_STARTED, skipped; set it after the activating restart (or pass --default-start-ts for ad-hoc runs). New experiments self-register by appending an entry. NOTE: all four share one activation restart, so attribution is BUNDLE-level until they diverge.
